app.name: Bridge
app.tagline: Local developers and organisations working on real problems.

panel.title: How it works
panel.publish: Developers publish a solution to a real problem, with timestamped evidence of what they submitted and when.
panel.review: Verified people at organisations that accepted our NDA can read the full details, and every view is logged.
panel.track: Both sides follow one shared tracker, from the first look to an agreed next step.

landing.title: Bring local solutions to the organisations that need them
landing.lead: Developers publish solutions to real problems. Organisations review them under NDA and agree the next step, and both sides follow the same tracker.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: It takes a minute. We will email you a link to confirm your address.
signup.sideDeveloperHint: I build solutions to real problems.
signup.sideOrgHint: We have problems to solve and want to review solutions.
signup.displayNameHint: Shown to the people you work with here.
signup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence you will remember works well.
signup.orgNameHint: The registered name, as on your documents.
signup.consentsHint: Each is a separate choice, and you can change it later.
signup.consentMarketing: Send me occasional product news by email. You can stop at any time.
signup.consentReminders: Send me reminders about my proposals and engagements by email.
signup.consentWhatsapp: Send me reminders on WhatsApp (available later).
signup.consentProfiling: Use my niches and activity to recommend problems and proposals, with an explanation for each.
signup.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of service<hint> (opens in a new tab)</hint></terms>

validation.side: Choose whether you are joining as a developer or for an organisation.
validation.emailFormat: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.passwordLength: Use a password of at least 12 characters.
validation.terms: Accept the terms of service to create an account.
validation.code: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
validation.recoveryCode: Enter one of your recovery codes.
validation.emailForLink: Enter your email address so we can send you a sign-in link.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signup: Open the link we sent to {email} within {minutes} minutes to confirm your address and sign in.
checkEmail.login: If {email} has an account, open the link we sent it within {minutes} minutes to sign in.
checkEmail.noEmail: Open the link we sent you within {minutes} minutes to continue.
checkEmail.resent: We sent another link. If it has not arrived in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

login.title: Log in
login.lead: Use your email and password, or get a sign-in link by email.

link.title: Signing you in
link.failedLead: Links work once and expire after {minutes} minutes. Enter your email and we will send a new one.

mfa.title: Enter your code
mfa.lead: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6‑digit code.
mfa.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in, like k7mq-x2pd.
mfa.useApp: Use a code from my app

security.title: Two-step sign-in
security.lead: Each time you log in, you will also enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone.
security.step1: Add your account to an authenticator app
security.step1Body: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app. If you cannot scan it, type the key instead.
security.qrLabel: QR code that adds your account to an authenticator app
security.codesLead: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager: we will not show them again.
security.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the text and copy it instead.
security.mandatory: Your role requires two-step sign-in, so it stays on.
security.stepUp: To turn it off, enter the current code from your authenticator app.

home.title: Welcome, {name}
home.devLead: Your developer home is being built. For now, you can choose how you sign in.
home.orgLead: You are signed in for {org}. Your organisation’s home is being built.
home.orgLeadNoName: Your organisation’s home is being built.
home.mfaRequired: Two-step sign-in is off. Your role needs it, and it takes about two minutes to turn on.

errors.invalid_email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.terms_not_accepted: Accept the terms of service to create an account.
errors.org_details_required: Enter your organisation’s name and type.
errors.weak_password: Use a password of at least 12 characters that is not your email address.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match an account. Check them, or email yourself a sign-in link.
errors.email_unverified: Confirm your email address first. We have sent you a new link.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.invalid_or_expired_link: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.invalid_code: That code did not work. Enter the newest code from your authenticator app.
errors.no_pending_enrolment: Start the setup again to get a new key.
errors.mfa_mandatory_for_role: Your role requires two-step sign-in, so it cannot be turned off.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session changed. Reload the page, then try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Log in again.
errors.mfa_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
errors.step_up_required: Confirm with the current code from your authenticator app to continue.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection, then try again.

errorPage.title: This page did not load
errorPage.body: We could not reach the server. Check your connection, then try again.
